SayText Chat v1.0 is now published 🚀 

Ever wanted to chat like you're playing Counter-Strike 1.6 again? Now you can! 🥳 

With this retro chat app, you can send text messages as CT, T or SPEC, issue radio commands, or let the VOX speech system speak on your behalf! 💬 

There is also a leetspeak transformer, and various background images available. 💡 

➡️ Check it out:
https://github.com/danielbrendel/saytext-chat
